successCriteria.description: A vitest suite exists at web/src/modules/approvals/approvals.service.test.ts (beside its subject) that imports ApprovalsService, IApprovalsService, and ApprovalsQueueItem from the Phase 1 module and uses in-memory vi.fn() fakes for ILeaveService and IEmployeeService.

getQueue() happy path is covered: given a MANAGER/ADMIN profile and a list containing SUBMITTED rows (including the viewer's own) plus DRAFT/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED rows, the result contains only SUBMITTED rows whose employeeId !== profile.id, and every returned item has employeeName === null and status === LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED.
getQueue() empty state is covered: when no SUBMITTED non-own rows exist, getQueue() resolves to [] (asserted as a normal condition, not a rejection).
getQueue() failure path is covered: when getMe() or list() rejects, the rejection propagates unchanged (asserted via await expect(...).rejects.toBe(error)).
decide(requestId, 'approve') is covered: it delegates to leaveService.approve(requestId) exactly once and returns the LeaveRequestView unchanged (identity asserted with toBe).
decide(requestId, 'reject') is covered: it delegates to leaveService.reject(requestId) exactly once and returns the LeaveRequestView unchanged (identity asserted with toBe).
decide() failure path is covered: when the underlying approve/reject rejects, the rejection propagates unchanged.

constraints: Tests must use in-memory fakes cast to ILeaveService and IEmployeeService (imported from web/src/modules/leave/index.ts and web/src/modules/employee/index.ts), never the real LeaveService/EmployeeService or any API client.

Fake methods must be vi.fn() and call arguments asserted with toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)/toHaveBeenCalledWith(...)/not.toHaveBeenCalled(); unused fake methods default to Promise.reject(new ApiError('unused', 0)).
ApiError is imported from '../../infrastructure/api/index' (matching existing service tests) and used as the rejection value for error-propagation assertions.
The test file must not assert any role-based branching in getQueue() — the implementation never reads profile.role; a MANAGER/ADMIN profile is used only as the profile fixture value.
The suite must not modify or re-implement ApprovalsService, IApprovalsService, ApprovalsQueueItem, or ApprovalDecision — it only exercises the Phase 1 subject.
outOfScope: Any role-based authorization logic or role checks in getQueue() — the implementation has none, and the test must not assert one.
Testing the real LeaveService/EmployeeService or the API client — only in-memory fakes are used.
Modifying or extending ApprovalsService, IApprovalsService, ApprovalsQueueItem, or ApprovalDecision — this phase only adds the test suite.

entityInvariants.invariant: Every item returned by getQueue() is a derived read-model projection: status is always LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED and employeeName is always null (never persisted, never populated from another employee's name).

Membership is computed from LeaveRequestView rows where view.status === LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED AND view.employeeId !== profile.id; the viewer's own SUBMITTED rows and all non-SUBMITTED rows are excluded.

decide is a verbatim delegation: 'approve' → leaveService.approve(requestId), any other action → leaveService.reject(requestId), returning the resulting LeaveRequestView unchanged with no transformation.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Rejections from employeeService.getMe() or leaveService.list() propagate unchanged to the caller (no swallowing, no wrapping).
Rejections from leaveService.approve/reject propagate unchanged to the caller.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The test suite must match the fake/assertion style of the existing web service tests (factory functions with overrides, unused methods rejecting with ApiError, toBe for identity, toEqual for value equality, rejects.toBe for propagation).

The test suite must match the fake/assertion style of the existing web service tests (factory functions with overrides, unused methods rejecting with ApiError, toBe for identity, toEqual for value equality, rejects.toBe for propagation).
Fake ILeaveService methods must match the exact signatures declared by the interface (list, getById, create, submit, approve, reject, cancel).
Fake IEmployeeService must match the exact signature declared by the interface (getMe).
Test fixtures for LeaveRequestView and EmployeeProfile must satisfy the full field shapes (14 and 10 fields respectively) and use the LeaveStatus/EmployeeRole/LeaveTypeCode enums.
The test must import ApprovalsService, IApprovalsService, and ApprovalsQueueItem from the Phase 1 module exports.
